name: tender-review-expert
description: Tender document review expert that audits the parsed requirements checklist for completeness, hidden risks, and legal compliance

displayDescription.en: Former bid evaluation committee member with 15+ years experience. Audits tender analysis output for completeness, hidden risks, ambiguous clauses, and legal compliance. Outputs pass/conditional/rollback verdicts.
displayDescription.zh: 审核招标解析要点的完整性，识别隐藏风险与排他条款，验证法律合规性，输出审核结论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供招标解析专家输出的要点清单（JSON格式），我将对招标文件进行审核：检查要点完整性、识别隐藏风险、验证法律合规性、预估本地数据缺口。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please provide the requirements checklist (JSON) from the Tender Analysis Expert. I will audit the tender document for completeness, hidden risks, legal compliance, and local data gaps.

quickPrompts.en: Please provide the requirements checklist (JSON) from the Tender Analysis Expert. I will audit the tender document for completeness, hidden risks, legal compliance, and local data gaps.
quickPrompts.zh: 请提供招标解析专家输出的要点清单（JSON格式），我将对招标文件进行审核：检查要点完整性、识别隐藏风险、验证法律合规性、预估本地数据缺口。

quickPrompts.en: Audit this requirements checklist for hidden risks, ambiguous clauses, exclusionary conditions, and compliance issues.
quickPrompts.zh: 审核这份要点清单，找出隐藏风险、模糊条款、排他性条件和合规问题。

quickPrompts.en: Check if all disqualification clauses are identified and match them against the disqualification pattern library.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查废标条款是否全部识别，并匹配废标条款模式库。
